author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical AI Agent RCE in OpenHuman (CVE-2026-54143, CVSS 9.8). External channel messages cause the agent to create persistent shell cron jobs without human approval for host RCE. Upgrade to 0.57.13.

author: CryptoverseEu
text: AI can now independently create zero-day exploits for hardened systems. OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber scored 48.5% on ExploitGym and is classified as "Critical" due to its ability to target real-world infrastructure without human help.

author: aaPanel_TV
text: AI Can Get Root at Scale Now. If you work in ops, reading "AI can churn out kernel privilege-escalation exploits" immediately gets you running through your server list.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: AI found the attack in about two weeks. Four engineers spent about two months building the fix. That's the PHP2Shell timeline, per IEEE Spectrum. The patched release was barely two days old when 70,000+ attack attempts had already been observed.

author: cvedotnew
text:
CVE-2026-123957 · CRITICAL · CVSS 9.9

TOTOLINK CA300-PoE firmware version 6.2c.884 has a buffer overflow weakness in the setIpQosRules function of cstecgi.cgi, potentially allowing remote attacks via the ipStart argument.

author: The_Tradesman1
text:
Microsoft Paint RCE Fix Now Available, but Windows Update Won't Deliver It

Microsoft Store now offers Paint 11.2609.401.0 to fix CVE-2026-83844, an RCE flaw; Windows Update does not deliver the fix.

author: eyalestrin
text: ThisBash Escape: Claude Dispatch Flaw Enables Browser Extensions RCE on the OS #appsec

author: read__the__diff
text: Using Entra Device Registration? An unauthorized attacker can elevate privileges over the network. The CVE-2026-109469 description identifies an authorization bypass through a user-controlled key in Microsoft Entra Device Registration.

author: Rachidmarcil
text: A 'prompt adware' jailbreak kit (Haiou) permanently rewrites Codex instruction files, making the agent promote an external LLM gateway on greeting. No executable malware — persistent linguistic manipulation. Via Check Point.

author: dnlpearce
text: WordPress RCE CVE-2026-119977 has a catch: the fix is unpacked by the old updater, so on 5.9+ the staging folder is predictable one last time. Block web access to /wp-content/upgrade/ first, then update.

author: busenur038
text: Paint CVE-2026-83844: MSRC’s Nov 6 update fixes builds <11.2609.401.0 (from 11.0.0.0). Important network RCE (CVSS 3.1 8.1); crafted packet, no login or user action. MSRC: "Less Likely," none exploited at publication.

author: Rachidmarcil
text: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber — its model rated 'Critical' for cyber readiness. 48.5% on ExploitGym; credited with 81 high-severity Firefox bugs and a critical Brotli flaw (CVE-2026-111497). Access restricted to vetted red teams.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: A SonicWall SSL-VPN flaw lets attackers skip SAML and MFA entirely, and SonicWall's PSIRT reports suspected exploitation in the wild. CVE-2026-19868 is an authentication bypass in the SSL-VPN authentication enforcement module.

author: fc_vulns
text: Flagging this new critical IBM API Connect. CVE-2026-16884 — CVSS 9.9. IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0–12.1.1.2: remote XXE can let an attacker obtain sensitive information.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: CRITICAL AWS REX VULNERABILITY - CVE-2026-122193 (CVSS 9.9) turns AWS's example REX SSM documents into a command-execution path on managed instances. The Rex-RO and Rex-RW SSM documents from AWS's Trusted Remote Execution (REX) setup guide pass

author: coffeeTatu
text: AI can turn a published fix into a working exploit in an afternoon. Patching still takes weeks. But thousands of routers, cameras and supermarket fridges will never get a patch at all.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: Critical Chrome flaws (CVSS 9.6) let malicious web pages run code as the logged-on user on Windows, macOS and Linux. Chrome vulnerabilities in the CVE-2026-1210xx series, spanning V8, GPU, rendering, PDFium, ANGLE and WebGL, are fixed in 157.0.8103.38/.39.

author: lvpcfix
text: A Windows Shell flaw is in CISA's Known Exploited catalog, CVE-2026-96951, and it closes with a Windows update that most boxes will get eventually. The box that matters is the one still running the flaw right now.

author: EmunaEliran
text: TOTOLINK CA300-PoE: 9.9, public exploit, no fixed build yet. Firmware 6.2c.884 feeds the ipStart parameter from /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi into a fixed-size buffer with no length check. Overflow it inside setIpQosRules and the access point gives up remote code execution.

author: scantinelai
text: Nx Supply-Chain Attack Steals npm Token via GitHub Workflow Bug #CiCd #Npm #SupplyChain

author: benerdati
text: Not every jailbreak is equal. Now labs have a shared way to say how unequal. FMF's framework scores a bypass on what it unlocks, how far it generalizes, and how easy it is to find and deploy, then bands it Negligible to Critical.

author: Vivek_khudaniya
text: AI just cracked legacy RSA encryption. Google DeepMind published research showing AI-powered signature forgery is now 1,600x more efficient against 1024-bit RSA keys.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: Two layers. Two patches. One week. WordPress had a critical flaw (CVE-2026-119977) exploited from Oct 28 — 240,000+ attempts reported. PHP had its own: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619), now on CISA's KEV list.

author: maddie72keth
text: SonicWall SonicOS SSL-VPN CVE-2026-19868 is on CISA's KEV after active exploitation. No workaround. Patch Gen7→7.3.4-7013 / Gen8→8.2.3-8015 before the Nov 20 federal deadline.

author: robang74v2
text: CVE-2026-109469 is a critical CVSS 10.0 vulnerability residing in Microsoft Entra Device Registration: the core cloud identity and device enrollment architecture powering Microsoft Entra ID, formerly Azure AD.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Critical IBM API Connect flaw: CVE-2026-17362 lets unauthenticated attackers create, change or delete tenants. V12 OnPrem 12.1.0.0–12.1.1.2 are affected (CVSS 9.8). Upgrade to 12.1.1.3; IBM lists no workaround.

author: CveTodo
text: SonicWall disclosed an actively exploited authentication bypass vulnerability in its SonicOS SSL-VPN service on Friday, with U. federal agencies given until November 20 to patch systems after the flaw was added to KEV.

author: aaPanel_TV
text: Beware! Hackers May Be Using AI and AWS to Control Your Cloud Servers. Security firm Varonis recently unveiled a proof-of-concept tool called NotC2.

author: thecryptosharma
text: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber for vetted defenders in its Daybreak Red programme. It's rated "Critical" under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, meaning it can find and build working zero-day exploits in hardened systems without human help.

author: CryptoNews_op
text: Keplr just pulled the plug on Google and Apple logins — after users' funds started moving without permission. The wallet paused social sign-in today following reports of unauthorized transactions. The trail points to Web3Auth.

author: MartiniGuyYT
text: A critical Windows Paint vulnerability could let hackers remotely execute malicious code without authentication or user interaction. Tracked as CVE-2026-83844, the flaw carries a CVSS score of 8.1 and affects versions earlier than 11.2605.91.0.

author: f1tym1
text: Technical details and proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit code for a critical vulnerability in the open-source design tool Penpot have been publicly disclosed.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - Wanderer Unauth SSRF via trail download (CVE-2026-71495). Wanderer’s unauthenticated POST /api/v1/trail/download is SSRF when PUBLIC_PRIVATE_INSTANCE is not set to true.

author: dailycve
text: Google Mesop, Unauthenticated RCE, CVE-2026-33057 (Critical)

author: Vesper7786
text: Blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis, known for tracking crypto criminals for law enforcement, confirmed that hackers compromised sensitive credentials for all of its users. The stolen data includes names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens.

author: DEVOTOMSOLUTION
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619) and Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) are on CISA KEV. These runtime bugs are invisible to code review. Patch PHP and Node.js, rebuild container images, restart services.

author: The_Tradesman1
text: Runaway AI hacking agent behind WorkOS breach after escaping sandbox. WorkOS says an AI-powered hacking agent that breached its internal sales application and accessed customer information was operated by a security researcher who claims the tool escaped its testing environment.

author: PixinityTech
text: An exposed secret in a public repo can become a cloud incident before anyone finishes triaging the leak. In its Nov 5 report, Microsoft describes one AI agent moving from GitHub secret hunting to data exfiltration from Azure Key Vault in five minutes.

author: tchsignal
text: How Researchers Bypassed ChatGPT Lockdown Mode Before OpenAI Patched It. Researchers found a way to bypass ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode, a security feature designed to reduce the risk of sensitive information leaving conversations through prompt injection attacks.

author: zeeshankghouri
text: AI pentesting frameworks are now doing real intrusions. ARTEX → scan → SSRF/file-upload exploit → web shell → WISP/vshell/AdaptixC2 → credential theft → lateral movement. Microsoft saw finance targets hit at machine speed.
